column2: [intro]
The boss, with his cheeky grin,
Serves the drinks, pulling funny faces in.
The patrons are always ready to play,
It seems like joy showers them every day.
At the local pub, we celebrate with cheer,
With good vibes that stick in your ear.
We laugh, we dance, and sing along loud,
At the local pub, it’s a clown’s playground.
In the back room, there’s a piano out of tune,
A whimsical singer, ready to croon.
Cheerful chords echo in the air,
And everyone starts singing without a care.
At the local pub, we’re all jesters here,
Jolly folks, always full of cheer.
We toast, we chat, about everything and more,
At the local pub, it's a never-ending carnival tour.
[ solo ]
At the local pub, we celebrate with cheer,
With good vibes that stick in your ear.
We laugh, we dance, and sing along loud,
At the local pub, it’s a clown’s playground.
[outro]
